description: Paid: 0.003 RLUSD per call via x402 on XRPL mainnet (xrpl:0), or 0.003 USDC on Base (eip155:8453). Pay per call, solves one question: What are the public suffix and registrable domain (eTLD+1) of this hostname? Parses one bare hostname against a pinned snapshot of the Public Suffix List (publicsuffix.org, MPL-2.0): public suffix, registrable domain, subdomain, matched rule, ICANN or private section, with the list version. IDN accepted (returned in ASCII and Unicode). Local only; no DNS, WHOIS or RDAP lookup; not an ownership, availability or trust statement. Without payment this returns isError with the x402 PaymentRequired object (fresh invoiceId); retry with the signed payload in _meta["x402/payment"] or the payment_signature argument. Unpaid calls cost nothing.

host.description: bare hostname, e.g. www.example.co.uk (no scheme, path or port)

include_private.description: 1 (default) or 0 to ignore the PRIVATE section of the list

payment_signature.description: Optional. Base64 x402 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value (signed RLUSD or USDC PaymentPayload) for hosts that cannot set _meta["x402/payment"]. Omit on the first call to receive the payment requirements.

name: public_suffix
title: Public Suffix (eTLD+1) parse (paid: 0.003 RLUSD / 0.003 USDC on Base / 0.003 RLUSD on Base via x402)
